title: metrics::render_metrics silently drops Prometheus output on non-UTF-8
description: In metrics.rs, String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap_or_default() is called on the Prometheus text output. If gather() ever produces non-UTF-8 bytes (possible with user-supplied metric labels), the entire metrics response is silently replaced with an empty string. The admin endpoint returns 200 OK with an empty body; monitoring sees no metrics and no error. Should use from_utf8_lossy or return an HTTP 500 on encoding failure.
